_meta.pass_criterion: PASS iff, under exclude_0.987 in the n >= 2 stratum, e3_species (production E3, species dedup) has a lower pooled union Brier than k/n with the 95% cluster-bootstrap CI of Brier(e3_species) - Brier(kn) entirely below 0, AND a higher pooled union AUROC than k/n with the 95% CI of AUROC(e3_species) - AUROC(kn) entirely above 0 (bootstrap over source genomes, B = 2000, seed 1729). Otherwise FAIL: E3 ships opt-in only. Declared before the run (INTEGRATION_SPEC.md 'Validation gate').

catalogue.what: E3 clade catalogue: PGFam-cached genome -> NCBI species taxid, family, order

definitions.cells: (answered amplicon, PGFam in the union of the re-selected reps' PGFams)
definitions.truth: PGFam in the source genome's cached PGFam set
definitions.kn: share of the n reps carrying the PGFam (n = len(reps), gene-less reps included)
definitions.e3_species: pfunc_estimator.e3_probabilities, neighbours_from_hits(filtered record, reps first, dedup species), clade_members(anchor, exclude source species taxid + source genome); empty-PGFam genomes excluded (empty_as_missing)
definitions.e3_genome: as e3_species with dedup genome (the Stage E/O validated setting)
definitions.hit_exclusion: score_genecap.exclude_self_record: genome == source OR prefix taxid == source prefix taxid OR identity >= tau
definitions.prior_exclusion: every catalogue genome of the source's NCBI species taxid, and the source
definitions.auroc: pooled over cells, ties 1/2; point from a 1,000,001-bin histogram (floor(q*1e6)); bootstrap CIs and deltas from 1,001-bin histograms (round(q*1000)); delta point = fine-histogram difference
definitions.logistic_slope: y ~ a + s*logit(clip(q_bin, 1e-3, 1-1e-3)) on the 1,001-bin grouped data (q rounded to 0.001), Newton; NaN when q has no variance
definitions.ols_slope_stageE: Stage E's union WLS slope = point-level OLS of y on q (exact)
definitions.bootstrap: calibrate_pfunc.boot_weights draw verbatim, B = 2000, seed 1729, unit = source genome (per region: amplicon = source); percentile 95% CI; paired across estimators
